title: The Covenant of the Lord's People and Baal's Temple Torn Down
description: The priest Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people that they would be the Lord's people. All the people then went to Baal's temple, tore it down, smashed the altars and idols, and killed Baal's priest Mattan in front of the altars. Jehoiada posted guards at the house of the Lord, and King Joash was brought down from the house of the Lord to the king's house and seated on the royal throne. The people rejoiced, and the city was peaceful after Athaliah had been killed with a sword at the king's house.
